summary: The existing openclaw-compat owner selects the pinned file set of the installed OpenClaw version: package_version + files keep the 2026.9.6 set, an optional packages map adds 2026.10.9 sets for memory-retrieval-warm, native-turn-provenance, agent-exec-auth-scope and model-flow-selection. One checkout now owns these patches before, during and after an OpenClaw upgrade or its rollback.
reason: OpenClaw 2026.10.9 preparation (S24 31/10): every pinned patch refused another version, and model-flow-selection refusing stops gateway-start. The sets were ported to the npm 2026.10.9 modules, rebuilt identically on a candidate installed in isolation on the S24, where the five patched model-flow modules import with their real dependencies.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-openclaw-compat-variants.py
tests.evidence: 4 tests on the captured 2026.10.9 modules: each variant applies atomically, idempotently, reverses exactly; 2026.9.6 sets unchanged; unknown version refused before any write; patched modules parse and the model-profile exports exist. Registered in ci.yml.

tests.name: test-native-turn-provenance.py, test-model-flow-selection.py, test-agent-exec-auth-scope.py, test-whatsapp-network-recovery.py, test-memory-retrieval-warm.py, test-runtime-sync.py, test-gateway-prep-stages.py, test-ci-registration.py
tests.evidence: Existing 2026.9.6 owners and their deploy/gateway guards green on this head.

capabilities.reason: Compatibility owner and pinned manifests only; no route, action or capability.

architecture.reason: Same owner, same manifests; an optional per-version map; no new store, scheduler or daemon.

limitations: No effect on the installed 2026.9.6: the owner keeps selecting the same files.

Not yet in the 2026.10.9 sets: whatsapp-network-recovery (its WhatsApp package version for 2026.10.9 is not pinned yet) and the Android filesystem patch (EACCES copy fallbacks, /proc/self/ns/pid) of openclaw-android; gateway-prep-stages stays 2026.9.6-only (diagnostic, never enabled by startup).
model-flow-selection 2026.10.9 is syntax- and import-verified; its behaviour is proven by the upgrade rehearsal on the S24 before any switch.
native-turn-provenance 2026.10.9: get-reply always builds its transport object, so a turn carrying only the ingress run id now persists a transport entry.
rollback: Revert this commit: the 2026.9.6 sets are byte-identical; nothing is applied differently on 2026.9.6.
